title: Property-Damage Settlement Standard, Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) settlement standard for approved property-damage claims.**

**Standard.** The property reimbursement starts from the loss the claims team verified on the approved property-damage claim. A property-damage claim bears an equal share of the stay's deductible: the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the same stay. From the verified property loss, every guest payment recorded on the property-damage claim, net of reversals, is subtracted together with the property claim's deductible share. The result is floored at 0.00 and then cut to the lower of the level's per-claim limit and the plan's remaining aggregate, which is the level's annual aggregate limit less the reimbursements, net of recoveries, posted on the plan in the current plan year; property damage carries no category sublimit. The property reimbursement is rounded half up to the nearest cent only at the end.

## Elements of the standard

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Verified property loss | the loss the claims team verified on the approved property-damage claim |
| Deductible share | the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the same stay |
| Guest payments | every guest payment recorded on the property-damage claim, less reversals |
| Floor | 0.00 |
| Ceiling | the lower of the level's per-claim limit and the plan's remaining aggregate; no category sublimit |
| Rounding | half up to the cent, once, on the final figure |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs, not the figures of any level)

A stay carries two approved claims, one of them for property damage. The level deductible is 150.00, so the property claim's deductible share is 75.00. The verified property loss is 6400.00 and the guest paid 1000.00 on the claim, none of it reversed. The net property loss is 6400.00 less 1000.00 less 75.00, that is 5325.00. The per-claim limit is 30000.00; the annual aggregate limit is 40000.00 and reimbursements net of recoveries this plan year are 36500.00, so the remaining aggregate is 3500.00. The ceiling is the lower of 30000.00 and 3500.00, that is 3500.00, and the property reimbursement is 3500.00.

With 30000.00 of net reimbursements this plan year instead, the remaining aggregate would be 10000.00 and the property reimbursement 5325.00.
